verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs and README say touch input becomes taps, clicks and momentum scrolls on the Mac, that Apple Pencil acts as the pointer, and that three-finger gestures behave as on a Mac trackpad. That covers touch and stylus mapping to host pointer events, though all sources are first-party. Missing for 10: detail on drag, right-click and hover/pressure mapping for touch and Pencil, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host

citations.quote: taps and clicks, scrolls with momentum, the on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text, and Apple Pencil as the pointer.
